"use client" // Ported from Sera UI (MIT, (c) 2025 Sera UI) — https://github.com/seraui/seraui/blob/main/src/app/docs/amazongift/amazongift.tsx import { useId, useState } from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" export interface GiftCardProps { title?: string amount?: string detail?: string note?: string placeholder?: string actionLabel?: string emptyLabel?: string claimedLabel?: string className?: string onClaim?: (code: string) => void } export function GiftCard({ title = "Gift card", amount = "$100", detail = "Enter the code, then claim it.", note = "Use the code within 30 days.", placeholder = "GIFT-2048-ALPHA", actionLabel = "Claim", emptyLabel = "Enter a code first.", claimedLabel = "Code claimed.", className, onClaim, }: GiftCardProps) { const patternId = `gift-${useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "")}` const [code, setCode] = useState("") const [status, setStatus] = useState("") function claim() { const next = code.trim() if (!next) { setStatus(emptyLabel) return } setStatus(claimedLabel) onClaim?.(next) } return (

setCode(event.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder} aria-label={title} className="w-full bg-transparent px-3 py-3 font-mono text-lg tracking-widest text-foreground outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground" />
